title: TRMNL Calendar + Weather
description: *TRMNL Calendar + Weather* is a custom plugin for the **TRMNL e-ink display** that combines a **weekly time-grid calendar** (powered by Google Calendar) with a **7-day weather forecast** and **air quality data**. Designed for the TRMNL OG's 2-bit grayscale screen (800x480px).

I built the entire plugin as a single **Liquid template** with embedded CSS and JavaScript. Events are positioned at their actual time slots (like Google Calendar), with overlapping events displayed side by side. Each calendar gets a distinct grayscale bar pattern for visual differentiation. Weather data comes from the **Open-Meteo API** and is rendered as mini-charts with precipitation bars, temperature lines, and sunrise/sunset indicators.

The plugin uses only the 4 native e-ink shades (#000, #555, #AAA, #fff) to avoid dithering artifacts, and gracefully degrades when any data source is unavailable. Published as a public **TRMNL recipe** with configurable location and timezone.
